verdict.rationale: Rippling publishes an official CLI under its own GitHub org (Rippling/rippling-cli), whose Flux commands let first- and third-party developers create, manage and deploy Rippling-hosted integrations. A probe confirms the CLI is documented there. Its documented scope is narrow, covering integration development only. missing for 10: evidence of CLI coverage of core HR/payroll/IT operations, AI- or agent-oriented CLI workflows, in-depth usage/install documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
